bluejetty:00027564:ios.description:
Ever dreamed of having your own shopping mall? My City: Mall is the coolest shopping mall you will ever see. 
Go and visit lots of shops with your pets. watch a movie, play games, dress up and eat fast food.
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
This game is a fully interactive digital shopping mall game in which you can interact with every object you see.The My City: Mall: game includes detailed and fun rooms that the kids can role-play as a shopper or even as the manager of the mall!
Shop,design and play with your pets and friends!
We packed this game with amazing new features:
*Lots of shops to play and interact.
■ Cinema - Buy tickets and enjoy movies with your friends while eating fast food like burger, hot dog, sandwich and of course popcorn.
■ Hair Salon - Play makeover games, change your hair color and hairstyle. Pamper yourself with the best makeover in the hair salon spa.
■ Arcade - Enjoy different funny games. Explore and design the arcade room.
■ Clothing Store - Bring your friends, animals and dress up with lots of clothing choices and use the boutique to shop for glasses, shoes and hats.
■ Food Court - Do you love yummy food like cake, sandwich and a lemonade? You can also visit the fast food area for some hot dog, burgers and popcorn.
■ Pet Store - Bring your cute pets in the mall. Adopt a cat, dog, parrot or hamster. Take care, wash them and interact with other cute animals in the pet store.
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00060807:ios.description:
Run your own grocery shopping & delivery business from your phone. Dumpling Boss provides you with a credit card to shop your orders, a personalized webpage, a community of business owners, tech support, and mobile apps for you and your clients. This includes everything you need to run your own grocery shopping & delivery business, including:
Client Management
•Quickly find & manage contact information for all of your clients
•Invite new clients to connect directly with your business
•Chat with clients via in-app chat or SMS
Order Management
•Save and upload grocery receipts
•View client's shopping list, re-order items on the list, and check off items as you go
•Edit client's shopping lists and add items they forgot to add
•Charge clients and adjust invoices
•Manage client order status and delivery date/time
Business Management
•Choose stores & services offered in your app
•Set pricing per store, including a minimum fee
•Choose either a flat rate or percentage based pricing structure
•Select who pays the credit card processing fees, you or your client
•Customize gratuity options
•Setup direct deposit
•Communicate directly with the dumpling support team
•Access the dumpling help center in the Boss app 
Business Insights 
•View earnings, order, and client statistics
•Manage client reviews 
With Dumpling Grocery | Boss, you're in control of every aspect of your business, from who your customers are to where you shop.

bluejetty:00067769:ios.description:
Simple Pomodoro Timer is a free simple and minimal Pomodoro timer.
With a design that does not disturb your thoughts, it will overwhelmingly increase your study and work efficiency.
- Overwhelmingly simple!
No unnecessary functions. No unnecessary functions to support your concentration.
- Start with one tap!
Just start the app and press the start button to start the timer.
- Switch between three timers.
You can switch between three timers with a swipe: Pomodoro Timer (25 minutes), Short Break (5 minutes), and Long Break (15 minutes).
This allows you to efficiently practice the Pomodoro Technique.
- Timer time can be freely changed.
Each of the three timers can be changed.
- Notification of end of timer by push notification
The timer will continue to run even when the app is closed or goes into the background, and a push notification will let you know when the timer ends.
You will never miss it again.
- Finish time is also displayed
Simple Pomodoro Timer shows the time your alarm will finish so you don't need to calculate when the timer will go off any more.
- Minimal design
The minimal design will not disturb your thoughts.
- The sound when the timer ends can be changed. Silence is also supported.
This is a good option for libraries and other places where no sound can be produced.
- Supports vibration
You can also change the on/off setting.
- Supports dark mode
Supports eye-friendly dark mode. It is automatically applied according to the device settings.
Terms of Use: https://tinylab-apps.web.app/TermsOfService/ja.html
Privacy Policy: https://tinylab-apps.web.app/PrivacyPolicy/ja.html

*Your favorite characters return from My Town : Home to shop with you

bluejetty:00024033:ios.description:
Photo Editor, is one of the most powerful design studios that fits in the palm of your hands. With over 50 million installs, Photo Editor is the premier all-in-one editor to fulfill all of your photo editing needs. If you're looking for an easy way to create unique looking pictures and convey a message, this is the way to do it!
Easily edit photos of any kind - selfies, food, architecture, scenery, and fashion. Use items like masks, captions, quotes, watermarks, and memes that you create in the app. Add beautiful typography & artwork, apply stunning filters and photo effects, and add an ever-growing collection of shapes, light FX, textures, borders, patterns, and more to your photos and share them to your favorite social networks. 
The beauty of Photo Editor is that you don't have to be a professional photographer or a graphic artist to create professional looking results. This app is designed to be easy and quick to use so anyone can benefit from it.
Photo Editing Features:
Stickers & Artwork
• Choose from a delightful collection of stickers, overlays & artwork to add onto your photos. - Expressing yourself has never been more fun!
Photo Filters
• Apply one of our 50+ gorgeous photo filters - with more on the way.
• Enable the Photo Editor photo extension in the iOS Photos app to natively apply Photo Editor filters when editing in your Camera Roll.
Photo Effects
• Choose from our carefully crafted blends of light leaks, film grains, textures, gorgeous gradients, magical effects, and more! 
Image Overlays and Masks
• Impress your friends by applying a collection of hundreds (and growing) of shapes, borders, overlays, textures and more to add that extra flair to your photos. 
Magazine Templates
• Choose from incredible magazine-style templates to create your own custom cover story. Announce your birthday party, baby shower or job promotion with magazine templates inspired by publications like Time, Forbes, People, Bon Appétit and many more!
Custom Artwork
• Import custom artwork or your own logo, and use it in your photos as a fully editable layer. This is perfect for the mobile creative, and a big plus to branding efforts everywhere.
Drawing Tool
• Perfect for those who want to draw some rough notes, instructions, captions & more on their photos. 
Crop Photos
• Easily crop photos using our preset ratios - including the popular 1:1 ratio - perfect for Instagram, or drag cropping tool to your desired width and height. 
Collage Tool
• Choose from our great selection of unique and fun collages. 
Photo Booth
• Endless fun awaits in the Photo Editor Photo booth. You'll never get tired of sharing your awesome photos with your friends.
Sticker Pack
• Fun set of iMessage stickers included with each download, with the option easily share images created with Photo Editor. 
This robust photo editing app for iPhone or iPad allows you to create unlimited fun, quirky, or professional photo edits. After installing this app, you will have access to the perfect photo editor for Instagram and for creating beautiful and unique pictures right at your fingertips. Easily upload, edit, and share as many photos as you want, whenever you want. No previous design experience or knowledge is needed to use our photo editing app. 
View our Terms of Service at: https://maplemedia.io/terms-of-service/
Download. Create. Share. 
We can't wait to see your creativity in action with Photo Editor! 
Support: contact@maplemedia.io
Happy Editing, 
The Photo Editor Team

We've now rebuilt the app from the ground up to make it even easier (and more fun) to hyper-schedule your entire day from a single place.
As you start integrating Sorted³ into your daily workflow, you'll notice 3 foundational benefits:
● Unified Timeline
Sorted³ seamlessly integrates your calendar events and tasks into one timeline so you can manage your entire day from a single place. To make things even more delightful, you can take formatted notes, attachments and drawings on both your events and tasks inside the app.
● Effortless Scheduling
Sorted³ helps you easily set a schedule for your day, and decide what’s important, what can wait, and what you reasonably have time for. You can use Auto Schedule to figure out what you can realistically get done in a day. Instead of feeling underproductive, Sorted³ helps you set attainable goals that you can accomplish.
● Built-in Flexibility
Even when properly scheduled in advance, days don’t always go as planned! Sorted³ is built with that flexibility in mind to adjust to your changing schedule. It's as dynamic as your day, with smart features such as Magic Select and our signature Time Ruler to help you shift things around with a few taps.
On top of all these, there are various other functionalities to make your experience more fun and seamless across all your devices:
- New Widgets for iOS 16 & macOS Monterey
- Auto Backup

- iCloud Sync
- Powerful repeat rules
- Light & Dark Themes

- URL Scheme

- And much more!

bluejetty:00029910:ios.description:
Spark: Your Ultimate Shift Calendar App
For over 15 years, Spark has been the go-to app for simplifying shift work. Loaded with powerful, user-friendly features, Spark helps you balance work and personal life in one place—trusted daily by fire, police, EMS, healthcare professionals, and shift workers worldwide. With Spark’s unique "Cloud Connect" system, you can sync and share your schedule across all devices, keeping you and your loved ones in the loop anytime, anywhere.
Why Spark? Here’s why your colleagues love it:
Full Customization
Spark is designed for you. Track and log anything you need—vacation, sick time, comp time, overtime, trades, and more. Can’t find something? Add it with ease! Spark’s sleek, intuitive design lets you personalize everything to suit your work style.
Secure & Reliable
Your data is safe with us. Spark’s "Cloud Connect" syncs your encrypted calendar across devices, linked to your email. Lose or upgrade your phone? Just log back in, and it’s like you never left.
Comprehensive Shift Coverage
From pre-loaded schedules to custom department setups, Spark supports thousands of shift calendars. Don’t see yours? Easily create it, and it’s saved for you and your team.
Streamlined Shift Trades & Swaps
Manage and track all your trades and swaps down to the individual. Spark’s “Trade Board” lets you request and confirm trades within the app, automatically updating your calendar and stats—no extra steps.
Instant Visual Cues
Color-code shifts, events, and stats for at-a-glance planning. With Spark, you’ll know exactly what’s on the agenda without extra clicks.
Unmatched Customer Support
Our app thrives on user feedback. We’re committed to fast, helpful support, with most emails resolved in under two hours. Spark evolves with your input, making it the app you can rely on for years to come.
Try Spark free for 30 days, and experience the app that’s helping shift workers around the world stay organized. Visit www.LeakyNozzle.com to learn more!

bluejetty:00024690:ios.description:
"Time Trap" got a long-awaited sequel! Explore this post-apocalypse world in all-around locations!
The experiments of the Ring of Time corporation didn't end after the incident in the Abandoned City. 
 Following a mysterious electromagnetic surge, the anomalous zone was transformed into Timeless. It is a unique world where space and time are distorted, but also new opportunities open up to heroes! Everyone who entered this zone became a shadow of his old self. The only way to escape from Timeless is to put together the Sphere of Singularity! So far no-one managed to gather all the Fragments of the Sphere. Now it's your mission to prove it is possible!
The game is TRULY FREE, the whole adventure is open to you without any additional purchases - it's entirely up to you to buy optional tools.
Game features:
- A variety of tasks: searching for items, spotting the differences, puzzles, restoration of disassembled objects
- Look for items in 360-degree panoramic scenes. Unusual 3D effects and colorful animations.
- Enjoy the exciting gameplay as the "Time Trap" storyline continues!
- Build your collection. Go through scenes again to try new quests and get new rewards!
We'll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp - make comments, ask questions, get news about coming games!

bluejetty:00032050:ios.description:
The GOLFTEC App is equipped with performance-enhancing tools, leveraging its on-course GPS and game-tracking features to provide insightful analysis of your play.
On-Course Performance
Play Golf with On-Course GPS
Our precise GPS tool calculates exact yardage distances to any point on the golf course. See the course in extreme detail with adjustable distances, Club selection recommendations, Coach strategy, infographic overlays and more
Green Views
Know the best place to land your approach shot or line up your putts with detailed heat map showing Elevation Change and Slope for every green.
Stat Tracking and Performance Insights
Improve your game with GOLFTEC's Performance insights. The platform helps you gather and analyze performance data from a variety of sources, such as on-course stats, launch monitor numbers, and swing motion measurements.
Improvement Tools
Record Your Swing
Use your phone with the GOLFTEC App to record or upload your swings from the front or side anywhere you want. The app automatically trims, automatically centers, shows club path and body motion. 
Review Lessons & Drills
Dive deep into your previous lessons with videos of your swings, coach analysis and drills from any of your previous lessons. You'll never miss the tips and tools you need to work on your game with the GOLFTEC App in your pocket!
My Game Management with Skills Challenges, Bag Mapping & More
See your club fittings, Skills Challenge results and make a digital catalog of your golf equipment where you can add your clubs and keep track of their distances. Just a few of the tools you can use to improve your game!
Book & Change Lessons
The app makes it easy to book your lessons, club fittings and practice sessions. With monthly views and easy-to-see availability, managing your schedule is easy.
Access to the Pro Shop
You'll have access to the GOLFTEC Pro Shop in the App where you can find curated golf products that help you play and enjoy the game even more. Current students and plus subscribers will also have special discounted pricing exclusive to GOLFTEC that can't be found anywhere else!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Easy Life is the #1 Translation and Object Recognition app available in the store. Translate text in images instantly by just pointing your camera. 
We believe in constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. That's why we're excited to introduce our latest creation: an all-in-one app that does it all.
Relax and unwind with our selection of meditational sounds and horoscopes. Our horoscopes are fun and easy to read, so you can learn more about what the stars have in store for you.
Magical camera for your all needs. You will be surprised at how accurate and intelligent it is! 
Most advanced AI is integrated into Easy Life. Easy Life identifies and translates everything!
** Features
- New feature Scanner module is added. You can scan and send documents in pdf's.
- New feature Sign documents by hand.
- New feature OCR images and send them by share kit.
- New feature biometric document security added.
- New feature face filters added.
- New feature horoscope service is added.
- New feature meditational sounds added.
- New feature cartoon filters added.
- The most advanced object recognition.
- Celebrity and face recognition.
- Translate any documents to the desired language.
- Export to TXT.
- Auto language detection, no need to know the source language.
- Supports 100+ Languages.
- Instant camera translation.
- Photos: Take or import photos for higher quality translations (90 languages)
- Country Prediction
- Text pronouncing: Let your translated text be pronounced by the App.
- Import images from google photos or apple photos app.
Note: The Free version may be subject to limitations.

- Text translation service requires a premium subscription.

bluejetty:00015439:ios.name: Math 24 - Mental Math Cards
bluejetty:00015439:ios.summary: Math 24 - Mental Math Cards is a classical math puzzle game. The game is designed to help people of all skill levels improve their arithmetic abilities and mental math skills. Elementary school students can also play it. But you may not sol
bluejetty:00015439:ios.description:
Math 24 - Mental Math Cards is a classical math puzzle game. The game is designed to help people of all skill levels improve their arithmetic abilities and mental math skills. Elementary school students can also play it. But you may not solve some questions even you are a graduate student!
■ How To Play
The rules are simple. Combine 4 numbers into 24 by addition(+), subtraction(-), multiplication(×) and division(÷). For example, try to use these 4 numbers: 2048 to make 24. The answer is (2+0)×(4+8)=24. The question is easy, but some questions are much more difficult. You can try this: 6 6 5 9 to make 24. 
■ Stage Mode
15 stages and 300 well designed levels in total. The stages are from "Baby" to "King of Math", from easy to difficult. Touch the help button at the top-right corner if you can't solve a question. There are 3 chances to use help button in each stage.
■ Speed Mode
10 random questions! Make 24 as fast as you can! Touch the garbage can button at the top-right corner to change a question. There are 3 chances to change a question in each game.
■ Game Center
"Math 24" is fully integrated with Game Center - providing both Leaderboards and Achievements. The Game Center features allow you to test your skills against the rest of the world and to share your scores and accomplishments with friends.
■ Features
- Well-designed levels
- Best user experience and graphics
- Exciting speed mode
■ The App is suitable for you
- If you like sudoku, brain training, math game or puzzle game.
- If you want to play with friends or family.
- If you want to improve you math skills, especially the mental math skills.
Have fun!

ADD SPEECH BUBBLES TO YOUR PICTURES!

*** Make Your Photos Talk with Pic Talk! ***
Turn your photos into fun, engaging stories with speech bubbles! Bring everyone’s thoughts and words to life with Pic Talk. Perfect for capturing funny moments, creating memes, or adding personal messages to your favorite pictures. With Pic Talk, your photos aren't just static images – they become lively conversations!
Features:
- Comic-Style Captions: Create unique, comic-style captions to add personality and humor to your photos. Whether it's a witty remark or a heartfelt message, Pic Talk lets you express yourself creatively.
- Customizable Speech Bubbles: Choose from a wide range of fonts, colors, and bubble styles to perfectly match the tone and style of your photo. From serious quotes to silly dialogues, make your speech bubbles as unique as your moments.
- Multiple Bubbles for Group Photos: Capture everyone’s words in one frame by adding multiple speech bubbles to group photos. Perfect for friends' gatherings, family events, or any photo where everyone has something to say!
- Easy Editing: Drag, rotate, and adjust bubbles with ease using simple finger gestures. Customize the placement and size to fit your photo perfectly. Pic Talk is designed to be user-friendly, so editing your photos feels natural and fun.
- Versatile Photo Options: Choose any photo from your library or snap a new one directly within the app. Pic Talk supports high-resolution images to ensure your photos look great no matter where you use them.
- Gallery Access: Easily edit your photos at any time from the gallery. Save your creations to revisit and modify later, keeping your memories fresh and flexible.
- Seamless Sharing: Share your customized photos instantly on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, or send them directly via email and text. Connect with friends and family by bringing your photos to life in a whole new way.

Your Pic Talk subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time in your iTunes account settings. Refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

bluejetty:00063955:ios.description:
Qobuz, a unique approach to online music.
With Qobuz, listen to unlimited music in the highest quality audio. Let our team of music experts guide you in your music discoveries with recommendations, human-curated playlists, and exclusive editorial content (articles, interviews, reviews). 
Access an unparalleled wealth of content: 
. Over 100 million tracks in lossless in high resolution & CD quality
. More than 500,000 original editorial articles written by experts
. Thousands of human-curated playlists in rock, classical, jazz, electronic, pop, funk, soul, R&B, metal, and more 
QOBUZ is the only platform to offer both music streaming and downloads in Hi-Res.
Listen to your music where you want, when you want: Qobuz is available on all your devices, even without internet connection in offline mode. 
▶ Discover and experience a high quality, authentic listening experience by trying Qobuz SOLO FREE and WITHOUT COMMITMENT for 30 days directly in the app.
• EXPERIENCE AUTHENTIC SOUND
- Enjoy an exceptional listening experience with high quality music, straight from the studio
- Enjoy new releases and reissues in lossless, in CD (FLAC 16-Bit /44.1 kHz) and Hi-Res quality (24-Bit encoded sound up to 192 kHz) 
• DISCOVER THE LATEST MUSIC 
- Explore the new Discover page for a simpler and more rewarding experience
- Take advantage of a plethora of unique editorial content for free: 
. News articles 
. Panoramas: deep dives on an artist, album, genre, period or label
. Artist interviews
. A Hi-Fi section to enhance your listening with the best audio equipment
- Design and features directly accessible from the magazine:
. A clean interface and simplified navigation
. A search bar dedicated to the magazine to filter your searches and quickly access the content you crave
. Instant access to recent articles and your latest listening sessions from your home screen via Qobuz widgets
• ENRICH YOUR MUSIC EDUCATION
- New: Lyrics now available and the player, redesigned to match the music.
- Access to digital booklets with liner notes, and all of the details behind your favorite albums.
- (Re)discover new and iconic artists and albums. Discover the most promising new talents and listen to thousands of regularly updated playlists, thanks to our team of music experts.
• BENEFIT FROM HI-RES COMPATIBILITY 
Qobuz is supported by the main wireless listening devices (Chromecast, Airplay, Roon, etc.) and is compatible with all types of audio equipment from the biggest and most prestigious Hi-Fi brands.
• TAKE ADVANTAGE OF QOBUZ CONNECT
Take full advantage of QOBUZ features on our Hi-Fi partners' equipment without any loss in quality.
Transfer and import all your playlists and favorites from another streaming platform onto the Qobuz app quickly and easily with Soundiiz.
Enjoying QOBUZ? Follow us:
- Facebook: @qobuz
- X: @qobuzUSA
- Instagram: @qobuz

As you dive deeper into the game, each puzzle grows more complex, keeping you hooked as you discover new ways to master the knots and guide your climbers to their goal.
Every level brings a fresh, exciting challenge, offering you the chance to conquer new puzzles, earn trophies, and reach the highest ranks in the Trophy League. Do you have what it takes to rise through the ranks, collecting trophies and proving yourself as the ultimate puzzle-solving master? The journey is filled with obstacles, but victory is within your reach if you stay sharp!
With the clock ticking, you’ll need to think fast, but there’s no need to worry – special features like the Time Freeze Booster and Hypercharge are there to help you when the pressure is on. As you progress, the puzzles will push your strategic skills to the limit, but with practice and patience, you’ll climb to new heights and unlock even more thrilling challenges.
Join the adventure today! Download “Go Climb!” and experience the joy of untangling ropes, collecting trophies, and climbing to the top of the Trophy League. With regular updates, new events, and endless levels, there’s always something new to explore. The climbers are counting on you – can you solve the puzzle and lead them to victory?

bluejetty:00030512:ios.description:
Fun Merge: Fruity Fusion Frenzy
Get ready to embark on a delectable journey filled with juicy challenges and fruity rewards! Fun Merge: Fruity Fusion Frenzy is a tantalizing puzzle adventure where you drop and combine mouthwatering fruits to reach the ultimate goal: a giant, succulent watermelon!
Game Features:
Fruit Dropping Delight: The core of Fun Merge revolves around dropping identical fruits onto each other to create bigger and more exotic varieties. Strategically position your fruits for maximum merging potential!
Watermelon Quest: Your ultimate destination is the majestic watermelon, but the path is paved with puzzles and obstacles. Merge strategically to overcome each challenge and get closer to your prize.
Food Chain Reaction: Every successful merge triggers a chain reaction, sending fruits tumbling down in a delightful cascade. Plan your drops carefully to maximize combos and unlock special bonuses.
Luscious Levels: Progress through a series of vibrant levels, each filled with unique challenges and juicy surprises. Discover hidden power-ups and secret recipes along the way!
Appetizing Art: Feast your eyes on a visually stunning world bursting with vibrant colors and mouthwatering fruit designs. The game's delicious visuals will leave you craving more.
Squishy Satisfaction: Experience the satisfying squish of merging fruits thanks to realistic physics and tactile feedback. It's a feast for your senses!
Join the fruity frenzy and satisfy your cravings for puzzle fun with Fun Merge: Fruity Fusion Frenzy. Download now and let the merging madness begin!

bluejetty:00031926:ios.name: Runestone Text Editor
bluejetty:00031926:ios.summary:
A plain text editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers, search and replace, page guide, and much more. It's like TextEdit but more powerful and optimised for iPhone and iPad.
Runestone is made by a single person with a love for text ed
bluejetty:00031926:ios.description:
A plain text editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers, search and replace, page guide, and much more. It's like TextEdit but more powerful and optimised for iPhone and iPad.
Runestone is made by a single person with a love for text editors and a vision of building the most lightweight text editor for iPhone and iPad that still has the core features for editing code.
Features:
- Syntax highlighting of many languages including HTML, JavaScript, JSON, Markdown, Swift, Python, PHP, YAML, and many more.
- Select one of the twelve standard themes including popular themes like Tomorrow, Dracula, Solarized, and One Dark Pro.
- Innovative find and replace for searching and modifying text while still viewing your file.
- Choose font and font size, including support for custom fonts imported using another third-party app.
- Show the line and column the cursor is located on.
- Uses the standard document browser for an experience similar to the Files app.
- Quickly navigate to a specific line.
- Automatically close opening brackets and quotes.
- Multiple windows on the iPad.
- Format code using Prettier.js. Supported languages include CSS,HTML, JavaScript, JSON, PHP and more.
- Choose text encoding between popular encodings like UTF-8, UTF-16, ISO Latin 1, and many more.
- Enable or disable autocorrection, autocapitalization, and smart punctuation.
- Set default file extension of new files.
- Open files in Runestone from the Share Sheet.
- Print documents.
Premium features:
- Choose between eight app icons.
- Show line numbers.
- Highlight the selected line.
- Increase line height and letter spacing.
- Disable line wrapping to allow horizontal scrolling.
- Show tabs, spaces, and line breaks using a selected symbol.
- Enable page guide at a specific column to easily tell when lines are getting too long.
- Add vertical and horizontal overscroll.
- Remember the selected language per file.
- Save file extensions and filenames that should always be treated as plain text files.
- Enable soft tabs and choose the width of the tab character.
- Specify whether pressing the tab key should insert a tab or indent the line.
- Adjust the scaling of Markdown headings and disable highlighting of code blocks in Markdown.
Runestone was built on the open-source framework with the same name. Find more information on the Runestone framework at github.com/simonbs/runestone

Every quiz has its own questions and its own set of nicknames, so each one gives you a totally different kind of name:
The Classic • Party Animal • Spy Codename • Superhero Name

QUICK, FUN AND EASY
Each quiz takes about a minute. Just tap your answer and go.
Nickname Generator is made purely for fun and entertainment. Nicknames are generated from your answers and aren't meant to be taken seriously!

bluejetty:00040803:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00040803:ios.description:
Consulte, acompanhe e entenda seu processo judicial de forma prática e inteligente.
Com o Escavador, você pode consultar, acompanhar e entender informações processuais relevantes citadas em Diários Oficiais e tribunais de todo o Brasil para você, sua empresa ou seu cliente de forma rápida e organizada.
Como o app do Escavador funciona?
- Encontre informações processuais detalhadas realizando consultas por nome, número do processo, CPF ou CNPJ;
- Monitore seu processo judicial e receba notificações de atualizações diretamente no seu dispositivo, com verificações diárias.
- Visualize documentos relevantes do seu processo judicial;
- Conte com o EscavAI, seu assistente jurídico inteligente, especializado em descomplicar o juridiquês e fornecer orientação personalizada: entenda as movimentações, peça resumos inteligentes com histórico e próximos passos, e tire dúvidas sobre seu processo via chat;
- Tenha sempre a confiança de estar atualizado: o Escavador é referência nacional na estruturação de dados jurídicos, com mais de 450 milhões de processos e uma IA treinada e sempre atualizada com as últimas leis e jurisprudências brasileiras.
Quais são as fontes oficiais?
- Diários Oficiais (Imprensa Nacional): www.in.gov.br
- Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF): portal.stf.jus.br
- Tribunal de Justiça de São Paulo (TJSP): www.tjsp.jus.br
- Tribunal de Justiça do Rio de Janeiro (TJRJ): www.tjrj.jus.br
- Tribunal Regional Federal da 1ª Região (TRF1): www.trf1.jus.br
[Lista completa disponível em: ajuda.escavador.com/cobertura]
_______
[AVISO LEGAL: APLICATIVO NÃO-GOVERNAMENTAL]
Este é um aplicativo independente, NÃO OFICIAL e sem qualquer afiliação ou vínculo com entidades governamentais. O Escavador é uma ferramenta de busca que facilita o acesso a informações públicas disponibilizadas pelos órgãos oficiais listados abaixo.
Transparência e fontes confiáveis atualizadas
O Escavador obtém dados judiciais de fontes governamentais oficiais, seguindo sua Política de Privacidade para garantir segurança e transparência, mesmo não sendo afiliado a nenhuma entidade governamental. Estruturamos e republicamos de forma independente informações de processos de Diários Oficiais e tribunais de justiça, promovendo a acessibilidade e transparência das informações públicas.
O Escavador facilita o acesso e o entendimento de informações jurídicas com soluções que conectam você ao que realmente importa.
Para saber mais sobre como cuidamos dos seus dados e das nossas regras, acesse nossos Termos de Uso: https://www.escavador.com/termos-de-uso

bluejetty:00045122:ios.name: Walkingspree
bluejetty:00045122:ios.summary:
Walkingspree: Making Workplace Wellbeing Engaging, Rewarding, and Fun
Walkingspree partners with employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations to help members build healthier habits through activity, wellbeing, and rewards programs
bluejetty:00045122:ios.description:
Walkingspree: Making Workplace Wellbeing Engaging, Rewarding, and Fun
Walkingspree partners with employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations to help members build healthier habits through activity, wellbeing, and rewards programs designed to increase participation and long-term engagement.
Important: Walkingspree is available exclusively through participating employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations. Individuals cannot register for or use the app independently without access provided by their organization.
Whether you're taking your first steps toward better health, participating in a team challenge, or working toward personal wellness goals, Walkingspree helps make wellbeing motivating, social, and rewarding.
Features
Activity Tracking & Goal Setting
- Set personal goals and track your progress over time. 
- View detailed activity statistics by day, week, month, quarter, year, or custom date ranges. 
- Stay motivated by monitoring your achievements and milestones. 
Connect Your Favorite Devices
Walkingspree integrates with many leading health and activity platforms, including:
- Apple Health 
- Fitbit 
- Garmin 
- Google Fit 
- Samsung Health 
- Other supported wearable devices and tracking platforms 
Challenges That Drive Engagement
- Participate in individual and team-based challenges. 
- Compete with coworkers through leaderboards and friendly competition. 
- Celebrate achievements with badges and recognition.
Points, Rewards & Incentives
Many employer-sponsored programs include points and rewards designed to recognize healthy behaviors and encourage ongoing participation.
Social Features
- Connect with coworkers and friends. 
- Encourage one another throughout challenges and activities. 
- Foster a culture of wellbeing within your organization.
Wellbeing Resources
Depending on your organization's program, members may have access to additional well-being experiences and educational resources designed to support physical, emotional, and overall wellbeing.
Multi-Language Support
Walkingspree is designed to support diverse workforces and offers multiple language options to help members engage in the language they prefer.
Notifications & Updates
Receive reminders, challenge updates, progress notifications, and important program communications directly within the app.
Member Support
Access support resources to help with device connections, program questions, and technical assistance.
Getting Started
If your employer, health plan, or sponsoring organization offers Walkingspree, simply download the app and sign in using the credentials provided by your program administrator.
If you're unsure whether your organization participates, please contact your HR team, benefits administrator, or program coordinator.
Need assistance?
support@walkingspree.com
Interested in bringing Walkingspree to your organization?
www.walkingspree.com
sales@walkingspree.com

Walkingspree partners with employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations to help members build healthier habits through activity, wellbeing, and rewards programs designed to increase participation and long-term engagement.
Important: Walkingspree is available exclusively through participating employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations. Individuals cannot register for or use the app independently without access provided by their organization.
Whether you're taking your first steps toward better health, participating in a team challenge, or working toward personal wellness goals, Walkingspree helps make wellbeing motivating, social, and rewarding.

Features
Activity Tracking & Goal Setting
- Set personal goals and track your progress over time. 
- View detailed activity statistics by day, week, month, quarter, year, or custom date ranges. 
- Stay motivated by monitoring your achievements and milestones. 

Connect Your Favorite Devices
Walkingspree integrates with many leading health and activity platforms, including:
- Apple Health 
- Fitbit 
- Garmin 
- Google Fit 
- Samsung Health 
- Other supported wearable devices and tracking platforms 

Challenges That Drive Engagement
- Participate in individual and team-based challenges. 
- Compete with coworkers through leaderboards and friendly competition. 
- Celebrate achievements with badges and recognition.

Points, Rewards & Incentives
Many employer-sponsored programs include points and rewards designed to recognize healthy behaviors and encourage ongoing participation.
Social Features
- Connect with coworkers and friends. 
- Encourage one another throughout challenges and activities. 
- Foster a culture of wellbeing within your organization.

Wellbeing Resources
Depending on your organization's program, members may have access to additional well-being experiences and educational resources designed to support physical, emotional, and overall wellbeing.

Multi-Language Support
Walkingspree is designed to support diverse workforces and offers multiple language options to help members engage in the language they prefer.

Notifications & Updates
Receive reminders, challenge updates, progress notifications, and important program communications directly within the app.

Member Support
Access support resources to help with device connections, program questions, and technical assistance.

Getting Started
If your employer, health plan, or sponsoring organization offers Walkingspree, simply download the app and sign in using the credentials provided by your program administrator.
If you're unsure whether your organization participates, please contact your HR team, benefits administrator, or program coordinator.

Need assistance?
support@walkingspree.com

Interested in bringing Walkingspree to your organization?
www.walkingspree.com
sales@walkingspree.com

bluejetty:00043936:ios.summary:

Sonali Bank Limited is working alongside with the government to implement the agenda of Digital Bangla
bluejetty:00043936:ios.description:
Sonali e-Wallet
Sonali e-Wallet is the mobile wallet apps of Sonali Bank Limited, the largest state owned commercial bank of Bangladesh.
Sonali Bank Limited is working alongside with the government to implement the agenda of Digital Bangladesh by introducing various automation initiatives. These initiatives enable us to ensure operational excellence as well as meet customer expectations by providing better services. As part of our digital transformation program, we have recently developed a dynamic and secure wallet apps that cater your daily transaction needs like Fund Transfer, Mobile Airtime Recharge and Bill Payments etc.
You will get notifications on your latest activity; see your transaction history, transaction summary etc. Sonali e-Wallet is bring very exciting and innovative services in the market to meet customer needs and demands.
• Both Bangla and English Supported
• Sonali e-Wallet is a secured app. The App requires your PIN number in two phases. First for login and second, for every transaction you need to provide PIN number. For transaction purpose you also need OTP along with the PIN number.
• You can add your Wallet Account name and change your Profile picture.
• Add Money from your Bank Account to Wallet Account and vice versa
• Send Money to other Wallet or Account 
• Fund Transfer through BEFTN
• Recharge mobile or pay postpaid mobile bills for the mobile network operators below:
o Robi
o Airtel
o Teletalk
o Grameenphone
o Banglalink
• Payment of utility bill through the wallet apps is also available.
• Credit card Statement and bill payment for Sonali Bank Limited Credit Card user.
• Checking your Wallet and Account balance is very easy through a single tap on the screen
• Receive notifications for your latest transactions.

Write, edit & manage your Google Blogger blog on the go!
► Easy Blogging – Create and manage your blog posts seamlessly with user-friendly interface optimized for iPhone and iPad.
► Powerful Editing – Edit your posts with our advanced text editor, complete with formatting options and media insertion.
► Discover – Feed to explore blogs, find authors and read new blog posts from Blogger community.
► Search – Instantly search billions of posts, authors and blogs across Blogger.
► Add Images to Your Posts – Enhance your blog posts by adding images with our premium feature.
► Schedule Posts – Plan and schedule your blog posts to publish at the perfect time.
► Secure and Reliable – Your data is safe with us. Enjoy a secure and reliable blogging experience.

bluejetty:00016187:ios.summary:
Ready to rule over the skies?
Are you a trainee pilot ready for a thrilling adventure in the skies? Start your journey today as a new pilot in this awesome airplane game that's been downloaded by over 100 Million players.
Your journey as
bluejetty:00016187:ios.description:
Ready to rule over the skies?
Are you a trainee pilot ready for a thrilling adventure in the skies? Start your journey today as a new pilot in this awesome airplane game that's been downloaded by over 100 Million players.
Your journey as a new pilot begins by choosing a plane of your choice in an airport Hangar. Don’t forget to inspect your airplane, test the controls, and make sure those engines are ready for a smooth takeoff!
It’s time for an epic takeoff! Show the world who’s the smartest, fastest, and toughest pilot around! Hurry Up Pilot! The passengers are waiting for you!.
Modes for Every Mood! 
- Classic Mode
City Explorer: Fly short routes between nearby cities with passengers
Time Challenge: Complete missions with strict time limits.
Global Adventure: Take long international flights & discover different places.
- Racing Mode
Checkpoint Dash: Fly through checkpoints in the sky to test your speed.
Aerobatic Challenge: Navigate through challenging obstacles showcasing your piloting skills
Mountain Rally: Race through rugged mountain terrains, tight turns & avoiding obstacles
-Simulation Mode 
Altitude Challenge: Navigate through high-altitude zones, & deal with air turbulence
Emergency Landing Drill: Handle emergencies and practice crash landings in tough situations
Rescue Pilot: Switch to a helicopter for water rescues, respond to distress calls to save lives
- War Mode
Ariel Battle: Engage in aerial combat, outsmart and defeat your enemy aircraft.
Ground Attack: Conduct airstrikes on ground targets, and provide support to your ground forces.
Naval Strike: Control naval aircraft, launching missiles to destroy enemy ships at sea.
Undercover Mission: Execute covert operations, sneaking past enemy defenses to deliver strikes.
Pick Your favorite flying machine! 
- Fly Mini Cessna for scenic exploration
- Perform cool tricks with precise flying with Pro ARF
- Race with Sierra P2020 for Speed & fun
- Perform tricks & stunts with Pitts 1400mm
- Annoy the hell out of your enemies with F16 Falcons
- Pretend to be a real pilot on the big Boeing 747.
- Experience realistic helicopter flying in Bell UH-1
Cool Features for Maximum Fun!
- Up to 100 Progressive levels
- Daily rewards: Play every day to earn free prizes
- Advanced flight physics experience
- Air control Support to crush your enemies!
- 360-degree movements in war mode
- Multiple control options – tilt your device or use a stick
- Fly in various weather conditions for an extra challenge
Tips for the Perfect Flying Experience!
- Learn the plane’s controls
- Understand & follow the signs on the runway
- Keep the plane straight when moving on the ground
- Lift-off at the right speed
- Follow all the checkpoints
- Maintain a high altitude over above the sea
- Gently guide the plane down for smooth landing
Navigate Like an Aviator, Land Like a Captain!
Guide your plane through waypoints, land at airports on time, and score big points. Slow down as you approach, watch out for crashes, and park like a flight captain to finish the level. Guide your plane to the runway and park in the marked area to finish the level.

bluejetty:00060585:android.name: Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw Driving
bluejetty:00060585:android.summary: Are you crazy enough to drive a Tuk Tuk auto rickshaw during your off days? Then Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw Driving Game provides you this chance at your fingertips. It can be exuberant for you to provide pick and drop services for your dear one
bluejetty:00060585:android.description:
Are you crazy enough to drive a Tuk Tuk auto rickshaw during your off days? Then Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw Driving Game provides you this chance at your fingertips. It can be exuberant for you to provide pick and drop services for your dear ones in our Tuk Tuk. Auto Rickshaw driving can bring fun part in your life by driving through big city. Picking and dropping the passengers and giving them pleasure of best auto rickshaw transport facility can fulfil your desire of becoming best tuk tuk auto rickshaw driver in the town. Going through the heavy traffic in the city in this auto rickshaw and giving pleasurable ride to the passengers can be a challenging task for you. 
Uniqueness and creativity are among the special characteristics of tuk tuk auto rickshaw driving game. You have to pick more than one passengers from one stop and drop them at different destinations. You will not find this feature in any other tuk tuk games. It will give you real taste of public transport services. You must have heard about fast racing cars, crazy taxis but this tuk tuk will make you drive as fast as you can. 
Following are the key features of tuk tuk auto rickshaw driving game:
- Tuk Tuk auto rickshaw provides the best pick and drop facility to the passengers.
- It picks multiple passengers from one destination and drops them at different destinations.
- As a driver limited time will be given to complete this pick and drop mission.
- In start of the game only one level will be unlocked, then you must have to complete previous levels to move to the next level.
- You must have to play same level again if you do not complete task within allocated time.

bluejetty:00062245:ios.name: Skiing Games for Kids
bluejetty:00062245:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00062245:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SNOW RACE
Snow Race is a new and exciting winter trial game loved by players around the world. It’s time for action!
Unlock awesome skier and snowboard characters. Race in fun and challenging single player levels or defeat your opponents in multiplayer mode!
FEATURES:
• Collect 10+ free snowboarders and skiers
• Do insane tricks
• Learn challenging downhill trial tracks
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00022367:ios.description:
Meet Geeni. Your wish is Geeni's command. 
Control all Geeni smart home and smart health devices in one easy app, from ANYWHERE in the world. Geeni is easy enough for anyone to use and combines the SIMPLICITY of an on/off switch with PREMIUM features such as: 
- Easy, powerful control of each device. Choose a color or mood of our Color bulbs, schedule a smart switch, check in on your cameras, and track your weight, all from the same app!
- Group devices and control by room
- Smart Health products support tracking weight, BMI, Body fat percentage, basal metabolic rate, bone mass, visceral fat grade, and more, and track on the app or sync to Apple Health
- Set smart scenes for automated actions
- Schedule when devices turn on and off to allow more control and security
- Choose which devices your friends, guests, roommates, or your family can control thanks to account sharing
- Cloud based services so you can log in and control your home from any phone
- HealthKit functionality for our new Smart Scale: synchronize your health data with Apple Health!
- and more. 
Compatible with all Geeni-enabled smart devices. No complicated hub required; each Geeni device is smart enough to connect directly to your home wifi network.

Whether you are using our platform to expand your customer-base or simply to manage your daily tasks, we created Vezbi for you.  

FEATURES INCLUDE:

• Vezbi Streaming – Watch your favorite videos, podcasts, movies, and TV shows in one place.  

• Community – Start your own private community or join a public one.  There's something for everyone here!

• WorkSpace - Collaborate with work, friends, and family.

• Calls - Call family & friends with audio & video calls.

• Intercom - Broadcast/Rebroadcast your thoughts to the Vezbi community. 

• SnipBits – 6 second looping videos to share a glimpse of a moment with your friends.

• Micro-vlogs – 30 second vlogs to take your followers on a daily journey of your life.

• Shop Now – Live Selling for a better perspective of your products and services.

• Events –  Create invitations (i.e. birthdays, baby showers, and meetings) and list/search for Pubic Events.

• Tasks - Create sharable task lists with your friends, family, and work associates.

• Live Stream - Take classes, attend shows, and watch vloggers live.

• News - Keep up with the latest news.

• Messaging -  Stay connected with text and voice messaging. 

• Micro-Apps – Access your favorite restaurant and businesses through micro-apps. Be sure to check back regularly as more and more businesses join our platform.

• Storage – Your private cloud for photos, videos, and files. Easy access and built-in privacy.

• GuardSmart – Smart personal safety tool with check-ins and secret alerts.


OWN A BUSINESS?  STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR CUSTOMERS THROUGH YOUR OWN MICRO-APP ON VEZBI.

MICRO-APP FEATURES INCLUDE:

• Loyalty Program
• Waitlist System
• Order Status Notifications
• Promotional Push Notifications
• Online Menu

bluejetty:00066058:ios.description:
Featuring your favorite heroes & villains from the Badland world. Survive epic quests in an unforgiving world & forge Alliances to survive and conquer the Badlands.
Featuring a never-before-seen, isometric, one vs. many free-flow combat experience that’s easy to play but hard to master.
COLLECT & RECRUIT SURVIVORS IN THE BADLANDS
Experience the life of Badlands survivor. Defy the odds and defeat Barons to gain their strength, each with their own specialized battle strategy.
UPGRADE YOUR FIGHTERS AND ROSTER
• Level up and customize your fighters to enhance their fighting strategies, weapons, and skills
•Customize your Badlands Team from a roster of 25+ heroes with unique weapons and combat styles. Unlock special abilities and powers with Rare, Epic and Legendary heroes.
• Return daily to earn gold, gems and powerful rewards.
FORGE POWERFUL ALLIANCES AND CREATE THE ULTIMATE TEAM
• Team up with your friends and other Badland survivors to build the strongest Alliance
• Strategize with your alliance, help them keep their team in the fight
• Test your Alliance’s mettle by battling it out with Alliances from around the world to become the Badland’s most fierce Baron!
• Rare Regent? Epic Baron? It’s your choice as you construct your roster while collecting heroes and villains from the Badlands.
BATTLE IN ICONIC LOCATIONS
Play & slay in the Pit, Quinn’s Fort, the Widow’s Lodge, Wall Street, the Dollhouse and other key locations. Search the lands for chests and unlock new characters via scouting.
DOWNLOAD NOW FOR FREE!

bluejetty:00027013:ios.description:
Your story lives in Richmond. Get in-depth stories from the leading real-time source for news, advertising, commentary and community conversations across Richmond, central Virginia, and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics. From reporting on all your favorite teams to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts. Support local journalism by subscribing today for unlimited digital access.
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Continue watching – pause a video and pick up where you left off across devices
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access to breaking news updates, analysis, and more.
Get The Richmond Times-Dispatch in Your Inbox
Get convenient, curated updates delivered to your Inbox. Sign up for Breaking News updates as they happen, the Afternoon Update for a roundup of the latest local top stories, Daily Sports for the latest sports headlines, Food & Drink for foodies, Virginia Politics Insider for the latest in national and local politics, and many more.
Visit https://richmond.com/newsletters/ to view and subscribe to all of The Richmond Times-Dispatch Newsletters.
Keep Up with The Richmond Times-Dispatch
Follow us on Facebook and other social platforms:
https://x.com/rtdnews/
https://www.instagram.com/rtdnews/
https://www.facebook.com/TimesDispatch/
https://www.youtube.com/user/RTDNewsroom
https://www.linkedin.com/company/richmond-times-dispatch/
About The Richmond Times-Dispatch
When Virginians look for their trusted news source, they turn to The Richmond Times-Dispatch. In addition to award-winning news reporting, The Times-Dispatch specializes in business, sports, and entertainment coverage. We also provide thought-provoking commentary and advertising solutions that drive results for local businesses.
We'd love to hear what you think! For any technical issues or questions, contact us at PWhelan@timesdispatch.com
https://richmond.com/terms
The Richmond Times-Dispatch is part of Lee Enterprises.

bluejetty:00029541:ios.summary:

Dream escape game for all the escape game addicts. It's filled with classical logical puzzles with lots of riddles. The amazing Dream play
bluejetty:00029541:ios.description:
If you like mysterious adventure games and point-and-click games, you’ve come to the perfect place.
Dream escape game for all the escape game addicts. It's filled with classical logical puzzles with lots of riddles. The amazing Dream play escape game filled with mysteries are waiting for you. Defy yourself with the wonderful fantasy world and logical puzzle. You have to search vigorously to gather the inkling with which you can break the baffle.
Easy gaming controls and alluring user interface pleases players from all age groups. Grab your detective hat and lens to find the hidden objects to plan your Escape plan. Put on your logical hat and solve the various number and letter puzzles to open the locks. Solve the riddles by investigating the clues found.
You will never get bored up with this dream mystery escape game as it has divergent levels and each level as different puzzles and themes. Our game was beautifully designed with colorful interactive graphics and dressed up with appealing game-play objects that alleviates your eyes. Make up your mind to jump into a game of logic's and fun. Observe, Analyze and use your logical skills to escape the mysterious Room.
If you are a big fan of room escape games, don’t hesitate to try our game! Very funny and relaxing! we promise to make the most unforgettable game experience for you! You have to find a way to escape from there by finding useful hidden objects, inkling and solve baffles, riddling puzzles. Use your skills to gather the necessary items in the fantasy world to escape yourself from the riddles.
Do you want to fall in dream just play and feel it.
Game story:
Story 1:
Frederick and Lena were a young couple, married for a year. They lived a normal life like everyone until that bad day hits their happiness. Before Lena could realize what would have happened, Frederick behaved rashly, hit her hardly and Lena was later hospitalized. Frederick could not find why he had behaved that way or even what had happened to him. He is embroiled in his dream and discovered he had suffered from a psychological disorder from his childhood.
Story 2:
A memory loss patient suffers with disturbed sleep. He hears his name being called loud when he was in deep sleep. The voice was disturbing him a lot and he wants to get rid of that permanently. So in order to come out of that situation, he decides to look back on the happenings in his life. For that, he is taking pills to recollect his old memories.
Story 3:
A teenage girl lives in an apartment. Her parents are staying in their hometown and she has come to the city for higher studies. His brother came there to stay with his sister for few days during the holidays. One day she saw her brother taking pills to dream of. She found out, a guy from the same apartment was selling the pills. With her tip, the pill seller was arrested and later released. The Pill seller abducts her in a room. He forcibly gave the pills until she got caught in a dream. Finally, she make an escape plan and escapes from the room.
Features:
- 100 Challenging levels
- More than 100+ unique puzzles
- Addictive story mode
- Amazing graphics and gameplay
- Family Entertainer suitable for all ages
- Humane hints for perfect assistance
- Unique three different stories
- Made easily understandable for beginners
- Challenge yourself by completing achievements

bluejetty:00063054:ios.name: Bridge Card Game Classic
bluejetty:00063054:ios.summary:
Classic bridge. Simple, clean, free.
Sit down and play contract bridge anytime with a smart AI partner against two clever AI opponents. Play at your own pace, in the bidding system you know. And when you feel like competing, try our new Da
bluejetty:00063054:ios.description:
Classic bridge. Simple, clean, free.
Sit down and play contract bridge anytime with a smart AI partner against two clever AI opponents. Play at your own pace, in the bidding system you know. And when you feel like competing, try our new Daily Tournaments.
PLAY YOUR WAY
- Unlimited free bridge against the AI, as many hands as you like
- Four bidding systems: SAYC, 2/1 Game Force, Standard American and Basic ACOL
- Your AI partner and opponents bid the system you choose
- Easy, medium and hard AI levels, from relaxed to challenging
- Rubber Bridge and Chicago Bridge with real scoring, kept for you automatically
- Fair, truly random deals from a cryptographic shuffle. No stacked hands, no favored seats
- Clean, uncluttered design for iPhone and iPad
BID THE SYSTEM YOU PLAY AT THE CLUB
SAYC: Standard American Yellow Card, 5-card majors
2/1 Game Force: a new suit at the 2 level forces to game
American Basic: classic Standard American, the kitchen-table favorite
Basic ACOL: the British standard, 4-card majors and a weak notrump
Switch systems anytime in Settings.
CLASSIC FORMATS
Rubber Bridge: best of three games. The first partnership to score 100 or more points in successful contracts wins a game.
Chicago Bridge: four deals with set vulnerability. The highest score wins. Perfect for a quick session.
NEW: DAILY TOURNAMENTS
Want to see how you stack up? Play the same 8 deals as every other player that day and see where you rank. Duplicate-style bridge scored by matchpoints, just like at the club. No sign-up needed. It's completely optional, so play it when you like.
NEW TO BRIDGE?
Bridge is played by four players in two partnerships, North/South and East/West, seated across from each other. Partners bid for a contract, then work together to take the tricks needed to make it. With a patient AI partner and unlimited deals, it's an easy way to learn and practice at your own pace.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Bridge Card Game Classic offers an optional weekly (1 week) and yearly (1 year) subscription called Premier.
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your purchase.
- Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost is shown.
- Manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- If you subscribe in another currency, the price may vary slightly due to bank conversion fees.
Terms of Use: http://www.bridgecardgameclassic.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: http://www.bridgecardgameclassic.com/privacy-policy/
We love feedback, good or critical. Use Contact Us in the app's Help section. We read every message.

- Rubber Bridge and Chicago Bridge with real scoring, kept for you automatically
- Fair, truly random deals from a cryptographic shuffle. No stacked hands, no favored seats
- Clean, uncluttered design for iPhone and iPad

BID THE SYSTEM YOU PLAY AT THE CLUB
SAYC: Standard American Yellow Card, 5-card majors
2/1 Game Force: a new suit at the 2 level forces to game
American Basic: classic Standard American, the kitchen-table favorite
Basic ACOL: the British standard, 4-card majors and a weak notrump
Switch systems anytime in Settings.

CLASSIC FORMATS
Rubber Bridge: best of three games. The first partnership to score 100 or more points in successful contracts wins a game.
Chicago Bridge: four deals with set vulnerability. The highest score wins. Perfect for a quick session.

NEW: DAILY TOURNAMENTS
Want to see how you stack up? Play the same 8 deals as every other player that day and see where you rank. Duplicate-style bridge scored by matchpoints, just like at the club. No sign-up needed. It's completely optional, so play it when you like.

NEW TO BRIDGE?
Bridge is played by four players in two partnerships, North/South and East/West, seated across from each other. Partners bid for a contract, then work together to take the tricks needed to make it. With a patient AI partner and unlimited deals, it's an easy way to learn and practice at your own pace.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Bridge Card Game Classic offers an optional weekly (1 week) and yearly (1 year) subscription called Premier.
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your purchase.
- Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost is shown.
- Manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- If you subscribe in another currency, the price may vary slightly due to bank conversion fees.

bluejetty:00041316:ios.description:
Trend Micro ID Protection shields your personal information and online accounts from identity theft, fraud, and unauthorized access. Stay ahead of identity and privacy risks. Enjoy peace of mind knowing your identity is secure and protected.
Lock down your digital security with data leak alerts, dark web monitoring, social media monitoring, and secure password management. Try it free for 7 days. Unlock Trend Micro ID Protection with Touch ID or Face ID.
Trend Micro ID Protection includes:
Personal Identity Monitoring: Monitors the internet and dark web to check if any of your personal data is leaked, reducing your risk of identity theft and account takeover attacks.
Social Media Monitoring: Monitors your Facebook, Google, and Instagram accounts for suspicious activity and potential hacks.
Anti-tracking and Privacy Controls: Prevents unwanted tracking on mobile devices and notifies you if you are in an unsafe Wi-Fi environment.
Cloud Sync: Synchronizes your information across all your devices.
Trend Micro ID Protection also offers comprehensive password management functions, including:
Autofill: Saves the usernames and passwords of your favorite websites so you can sign in with just one click.
Password Check: Notifies you when you have weak, reused, or compromised passwords.
Password Generator: Creates strong, tough-to-hack passwords.
Import Passwords: Quickly import passwords from your browser or another password manager.
Vault and Secure Notes: Stores not only your passwords but also other personal information in a secure, easily accessible location.
Smart Security: Automatically locks your ID Protection app when you are away from your device.
Trusted Sharing: Enables secure password sharing with your friends and family.
Trend Micro ID Protection safeguards you not only on mobile devices. You can use the same Trend Micro Account to access ID Protection on your computer and to download the ID Protection browser extension.

Trend Micro Incorporated, a global leader in cybersecurity solutions, helps to make the world safe for exchanging digital information. Our innovative solutions for consumers, businesses, and governments provide layered security for data centers, cloud workloads, networks, and endpoints. With more than 6,000 employees in 50 countries and the world’s most advanced global threat research and intelligence, Trend Micro enables organizations to secure their connected world. For more information, visit www.trendmicro.com.
*GDPR Compliant Trend Micro takes your privacy seriously and complies with the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR) to protect your data. Read ID Protection's data collection notice here:
https://helpcenter.trendmicro.com/en-us/article/tmka-19458

bluejetty:00018932:ios.summary:
The famous Braveland series returns! Destroy your enemies in online duels and uncover the secret of the king's scepter in this new turn-based strategy game.
LEAD AN ARMY: gather dozens of game creatures and create the most powerful squad
bluejetty:00018932:ios.description:
The famous Braveland series returns! Destroy your enemies in online duels and uncover the secret of the king's scepter in this new turn-based strategy game.
LEAD AN ARMY: gather dozens of game creatures and create the most powerful squad in the kingdom
EXPLORE THE WORLD: defeat the most cunning villains
FIGHT IN ONLINE DUELS: cross swords on the online arena with players from around the world
JOIN A CLAN: together with your clan mates, earn chests daily and help each other in the clan's tavern
CREATE ARTIFACTS: collect parts and create the best gear for one of your heroes
PLAY OFFLINE: play through the plot line offline for up to 7 days, stay in the game anywhere you are
BECOME A LEGEND: rise as high as possible up the kingdom hierarchy and become famous all over the world
The king's scepter of the Seven Kingdoms was perfidiously stolen from the throne room. The kings have summoned the mightiest heroes of magic and offered a generous bounty to the person, who returns it. In high spirits, you set off on a dangerous quest in the search of the royal relic. Use tactics to lead legions of heroes, fight the bosses and conquer other players! As you play, your army will be joined by various kinds of allies – archers, monks, demons, beasts, knights, and many others. Your journey begins in an ancient forest; you will pass through the southern lands and over the high mountains, you will encounter orcs, ghosts and mysterious nomads. In the north you will fight with might and main in the age of Vikings wars, rush into the clash of thieves and assassins, and try to bear the palm in fights of fiends and pirates.
Join the game community where you can find friends and find out the latest news: https://www.facebook.com/bravelandheroes

bluejetty:00065845:ios.name: Call Break++
bluejetty:00065845:ios.summary: Call Break is a strategic trick-based card game similar to Spades. It's very popular in Nepal and in some places of India. It's also known as Lakdi, Lakadi or Lakadia in some places of India. The vintage game of cards features 4 players wit
bluejetty:00065845:ios.description:
Call Break is a strategic trick-based card game similar to Spades. It's very popular in Nepal and in some places of India. It's also known as Lakdi, Lakadi or Lakadia in some places of India. The vintage game of cards features 4 players with 13 cards each to offer virtual gaming experience. There will be five deals/round in a game. Starting a game with a bid/call, a player can compete against 3 computer players with effective artificial intelligence. Initiating a game by throwing a single card of any suit (club,diamond,heart,spade), the other players also follow the same suit unless they runs out of that particular suit. Absence of identical suit allows player to throw a card of another suit and the current round is won by highest card. Spade cards can be used to conquer other cards when no more cards of the same suit are there to offer.e.g. 2 of spade can conquer any higher cards of other suits. If all the players run out of both identical led suit and Spades card then the led card wins regardless of any suit. Play and have a joyful digital experience of one of the legendary game of cards on your phone or tablet.
Features:
1. Simple and minimalistic UI design
2. Smooth animations, runs decently on low end and old devices also.
3. Counter-clockwise turn rotation like in real game play
4. Game play speed controller with 3 speeds (slow, normal and fast)
5. Trump suit (colour card) can be chosen by the user, default is Spades.

bluejetty:00015769:ios.description:
SWIFTSCALES was created by singers, for singers, and is the first app to simulate sitting at the piano with a vocal coach. Unlike other apps & audio lessons, SWIFTSCALES moves with you, as high or low, fast or slow as needed. You control every session in real time or passively, the only limits being the 88 keys of the piano and your imagination. No musical knowledge required! In fact, vocal coaches themselves can use SWIFTSCALES on the go to train and warm up students with exercises they already teach thanks to the app's endless flexibility, customization, and cloud sharing capabilities.
Whether beginner or master, student or teacher, SWIFTSCALES grants a lifetime of ever evolving vocal training. Singers, this is the app you've been waiting for!

-First user interface of its kind

-Unlimited amount of training variation
-Create your own custom scale patterns
-Professionally recorded audio samples
-Bonus Reading and exercises for novices
-Video Tutorials for using the app
-Contextual help on every page of the app
-Supports every mobile device size/shape

bluejetty:00061945:ios.description:
** Enjoy christmas with 36 lovely predefined mazes **
Each maze comes in lovely colors, background and characters.
Collect christmas artifacts and consume fruits as you make your way in the maze.
3 difficulty levels from easy to hard
Your kids will just love these wonderfully drawn mazes and will improve their skills while having fun! 
Our educational games are specifically tailored to fit preschool-aged kids, and encourage them to learn from each activity. We specialize in fun educational games.
Aimed for kids in the ages 1-6
*** What's New ***
* 20 Downloadable Puzzle Packs, over 1000 predefined puzzles.
* Variable puzzle size starting from 2 pieces up to 30 pieces for preschool kids and first graders!
* Play a new daily puzzle each day in 4 play variants - jigsaw puzzle, swipe puzzle, scratch card and color scratch
* Paint your own puzzles - paint by hand or import your pictures to create infinite new puzzles! 
* New Stories section - 18 first stories fit for ages 1-5.
* Create your own paintings, puzzles, stories and mazes
* New Language section with ABC letter tracing, Alphabet Sounds, Word Families, Sorting, Odd Words, Spelling and Writing 
* Dozens of games and learning activities including:
 +Learning numbers, 
 + Counting, 
 + Addition, 
 + Subtraction, 
 + Shapes, 
 + Colors, 
 + Order by size,
 + Order Numbers, 
 + Number line, 
 + Patterns, 
 + Tell Time, 
 + Matrix matching, 
 + More & Less, 
 + Great & Small, 
 + Big & Small, 
 + Long & Short, 
 + Tall & Short.
 + Bubbles shoot, 
 + Match, 
 + Memory, 
 + Domino, 
 + Maze, 
 + Cookies, 
 + Whack a bunny, 
 + Connect the Dots, 
 + Raining shapes
 + Animals Flow (New - 5 animal packs. 5x5-10x10 boards. 600 levels!)
 + Balloon Pop (New - learn colors, shapes, numbers and english ABC)
 + Animal Flow (New)
 + Letter Tracing (New)
 + Music Time (New)
Collect Stickers and a many more fun surprises! 
+ The game Does Not contain ads nor social links.
+ The game contains In App Purchases to unlock the base pack or subscribe to Tiltan Games entire educational library. 
+ The first 2 levels are open for free in each difficulty zone. Unlock all from the parents section.
Important things to know about the subscription:
• Subscription can be canceled anytime 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Payment is charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the app purchase.
• Account is charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing period at the subscribed price
• You can manage your subscriptions from your account on the AppStore 
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

If you're enjoying the game then we'd love for you to leave us a review! Reviews help small developers like us keep improving this game.
